upg100WallHeading: My UPG100 List — Prayer Lists & Posters
upg100WallIntroA: How would you feed a crowd of five thousand? Jesus sat them down in groups of fifty and a hundred, and the impossible became shareable (Luke 9:14). We did the same with the 2,106 unreached people groups: 27 lists of about fifty to a hundred. Each list prints as a prayer packet and a poster, so 27 disciples, churches or local leaders can each carry one — praying for them
